backgroundInfo.title: IS LUNA BEING STOPPED IN THE BACKGROUND?
backgroundInfo.body1: Some Android phone makers (such as Xiaomi, Huawei, OnePlus, Samsung, Oppo) aggressively close background apps to save battery. Because of this, LUNA notifications can sometimes be delayed, or your voice chat/room connection can drop while LUNA is in the background - this isn't a bug in LUNA, it comes from your phone's battery management settings.
backgroundInfo.body2: If you go to your phone's Settings > Battery (or Apps > LUNA > Battery) and turn off battery optimization for LUNA, choosing "Unrestricted" / "Allow", LUNA runs more reliably in the background. On some phones you may also need to grant LUNA "Autostart" permission.
backgroundInfo.body3: iOS doesn't close apps as aggressively as Android, so you're unlikely to run into this issue.
